entries.sentence: The Worker left this run's command unacknowledged, so the command bus delivers it again after a delay and the run continues from its last checkpoint.
entries.action: Nothing while it settles; if the same run repeats this line, read result_code and the lines before it.

entries.sentence: The Worker's output delivery settings are invalid, so this run's output could not be prepared.
entries.action: Check the Worker's output and spool settings, then restart the Worker.

entries.sentence: This run's saved output failed the Worker's validation, so it was not sent.
entries.action: Report the support reference to the platform team; the run's saved output is kept for inspection.

entries.sentence: The Worker's output spool is full, so this run's output could not be saved.
entries.action: Check the spool volume's free space and the Worker's spool limits.

entries.sentence: The Worker could not read or write its output spool, so this run's output waits and is tried again.
entries.action: Check the spool volume; the Worker retries within the run's lease.

entries.sentence: Main's output service did not answer, so this run's output waits and is sent again.
entries.action: Check Main's runtime listener; the Worker retries within the run's lease.

entries.sentence: The Worker's progress publication settings are invalid, so this run's progress updates are not sent.
entries.action: Check the Worker's output session limit, then restart the Worker.

entries.sentence: A progress update did not match this run's state, so it was not sent.
entries.action: Report the support reference to the platform team.

entries.sentence: Main refused this run's progress update, so the turn will be recovered from its last checkpoint.
entries.action: Read the cause; if Main keeps refusing updates for new runs, check the Worker and Main versions.

entries.sentence: Main's output service did not answer a progress update, so the update is kept and sent again.
entries.action: Check Main's runtime listener; the Worker reconnects on its own.

entries.sentence: A Map item or Parallel branch failed; this line names its own code, its fixed sentence and a safe cause chain, so the fan-out failure can be traced to one item.
entries.action: Find the item by item and item_ref (the support_ref of its failed join entry); member_code and cause say why it failed.

entries.sentence: A Map or Parallel whose worker or branch is a Code node sits inside a saved child pipeline, so the pipeline was refused before it started: fan-out Code runs only in the started pipeline for now.
entries.action: Nothing on the platform; the author moves the Map or Parallel into the started pipeline, or runs the Code inside a child pipeline without a fan-out.

entries.sentence: A fan-out node with Code items was refused before it started because its items cannot finish before the run's deadline.
entries.action: Nothing on the platform; the user lowers the item count or raises the node's concurrency, or the run is given more time.

entries.sentence: A Code node sits in a saved pipeline that another saved pipeline runs, so the pipeline was refused before it started: Code runs only in a saved pipeline the started pipeline runs directly, for now.
entries.action: Nothing on the platform; the author moves the Code into the saved pipeline the started pipeline runs, or runs that saved pipeline directly from the started pipeline.

entries.sentence: A conversation an older Worker paused continues on the unscoped resolver, where a saved pipeline's Code run as a Map worker or Parallel branch has no owner scope, so the pipeline was refused before it started.
entries.action: Nothing on the platform; the user starts a new conversation, which runs on the scoped resolver.

entries.sentence: A Code attempt was refused before it started because the run's remaining time is shorter than the Code timeout plus the observation margin.
entries.action: Nothing when the run was near its end; when cause is slot_wait, the Worker was full, so raise code_slots together with the Supervisor's concurrency.

entries.sentence: A Code item of a Map or Parallel was interrupted after it may have started and no owner proof showed its effect, so it ended typed and was not run again.
entries.action: Find the item by its support_ref in the run's failed join entry and check the target system for its effect; the run's other items are unaffected.

entries.sentence: A checkpoint reclaim met a root Agent node running a saved Agent, which cannot resume yet, so the run ended typed and nothing after that node ran.
entries.action: Nothing to repair on the platform; the user checks what the Agent completed and starts the run again.

entries.sentence: A checkpoint reclaim found a call receipt for a root Agent node that is not this pipeline's own call of its saved Agent, so the run ended typed and nothing was repeated.
entries.action: Report it with the support reference: the stored receipt names another occurrence, step or Agent, which only a changed or tampered row produces.

entries.sentence: A checkpoint reclaim found a root Agent node's saved Agent paused for a decision outside a continuation, so the run ended typed and nothing was repeated.
entries.action: Nothing to repair on the platform; the user answers the card again by starting the run again.

entries.sentence: A checkpoint reclaim could not validate the model checkpoint or answer receipt of a root Agent node's saved Agent, so the run ended typed and nothing was repeated.
entries.action: Report it with the support reference: the Agent's stored step does not belong to this execution, generation and definition, or it cannot be decoded.

entries.sentence: A checkpoint reclaim found a root Agent node's saved-Agent model checkpoint written by another execution, so the run ended typed and nothing was repeated.
entries.action: Report it with the support reference: a model scope is derived from its own execution, so another execution's checkpoint there means a changed row.

entries.sentence: A checkpoint reclaim found a root Agent node's saved-Agent session with events but no model checkpoint, so the run ended typed and nothing was repeated.
entries.action: Report it with the support reference: every stored model step writes its checkpoint with it, so its absence means a changed row.

entries.sentence: A checkpoint reclaim found that a root Agent node's saved Agent was inside a tool call that may have started, so the run ended typed and the call was not repeated.
entries.action: Nothing to repair on the platform; the user checks the target system for that call's effect, then starts the run again.

entries.sentence: A checkpoint reclaim could not read its checkpoint because PostgreSQL was briefly unavailable, so the delivery was kept and is reclaimed again until the run's deadline.
entries.action: Nothing when it is rare; if it repeats, check PostgreSQL connectivity and lock waits, since suppressed counts the reclaims kept since the last line.

entries.sentence: Main answered a Code visit or intent call with a retryable failure, so the Worker sends the same idempotent call again until the attempt's deadline.
entries.action: Nothing when it is rare; main_code names Main's registered cause when Main gave one (for example code.registration_contended), otherwise reason says how the call failed.

entries.sentence: A Code attempt that already held a Code slot asked for a second one, so it was refused at once instead of waiting for a slot it holds itself.
entries.action: Report it with the support reference: a code path acquires a Code slot inside another Code attempt, which must not happen.

entries.sentence: A Code attempt waited more than a second for a slot because this Worker was already running as many Code attempts on that Supervisor as its code_slots allow.
entries.action: Nothing when it is rare; if it repeats, raise code_slots together with the Supervisor's concurrency.

entries.sentence: The sandbox Supervisor answered busy to a Code attempt, so the attempt keeps its slot and retries with backoff until the Supervisor has room.
entries.action: Nothing when it is rare; if it repeats, more Worker slots share the Supervisor than its concurrency allows, so lower code_slots or raise the concurrency.
